source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cross_r = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 3 for v in row))
    cross_c = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h)))
    out = []
    for r in range(h):
        row = []
        for c in range(w):
            if r == cross_r or c == cross_c:
                row.append(3)
                continue
            dr, dc = abs(r - cross_r), abs(c - cross_c)
            filled = (dc % 2 == 0) ^ (dr > dc and (dr - dc) % 2 == 1)
            row.append(4 if filled else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-13fe1ca7.py'; path.write_text(source)
print(path)
